name: GitHub Repository
description:
Track today's stars, releases, pull requests, forks, issues, and discussions for GitHub repositories.

Add repositories via incremental config: key = owner/repo (or GitHub URL), value = event types.
  Example key: sidefy-team/sidefy
  Example value: stars,releases,pullRequests,forks,issues,discussions
  Leave value empty (or use * / all / true / 1) to enable all event types.
  Use false / 0 / off / disabled to temporarily disable a repository.
  Separate types with comma, semicolon, or whitespace. Unrecognized names are ignored; if none match, all types are enabled.

Supported types and aliases:
  stars (star)
  releases (release)
  pullRequests (pr, prs, pull_requests, pull-requests)
  forks (fork)
  issues (issue)
  discussions (discussion)
author: Sidefy Team

token.description: GitHub Personal Access Token (optional). Improves API rate limits; required for private repos and recommended for Discussions.
